mnemonic.meaning: Going (行) wrong (非). Delinquency, misconduct.
mnemonic.reading: HE, COKE (ひこう): he steals Coke from the store. Same sound as 飛行 (flight).

examples.ja: 少年の非行が問題になっている。
examples.en: Juvenile delinquency has become a problem.

items.note: 非行少年 = juvenile delinquent. Same sound as 飛行 (Level 17), flight.

mnemonic.meaning: 碑 has 石 (stone): a stone monument.
mnemonic.reading: HE (ひ): he stands in front of the memorial stone.

examples.ja: 公園に戦争の記念碑が立っている。
examples.en: There's a war memorial in the park.

items.note: Mostly in compounds: 記念碑 (memorial), 石碑 (stone monument).

mnemonic.meaning: Argue (論) and fight (争). A dispute, a controversy.
mnemonic.reading: RON, SO (ろんそう): Ron argues, "So, you're wrong!"

examples.ja: その問題について激しい論争が起きた。
examples.en: A fierce dispute broke out over the issue.

items.note: A public or academic dispute. A personal quarrel is 喧嘩 or 口論.

mnemonic.meaning: Cooperate (協) in tune (調). Harmony, working together.
mnemonic.reading: KYO, CHOW (きょうちょう): in Kyoto everyone cooperates to cook chow.

examples.ja: チームでは協調性が大切だ。
examples.en: Being cooperative is important in a team.

items.note: 協調性 = ability to get along with others (a common job-ad word). Same sound as 強調 (emphasis).

mnemonic.meaning: The year (年) you become (成) grown. Adulthood, legal age.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, NEN (せいねん): "Say, I'm an adult this year!" Same sound as 青年 (youth).

examples.ja: 日本では十八歳で成年になる。
examples.en: In Japan, you legally become an adult at eighteen.

items.note: Legal word. 未成年 = minor (under age). Same sound as 青年 (young man).

mnemonic.meaning: Choose (選) and think (考). Selection, screening.
mnemonic.reading: SEN, COKE (せんこう): sensei selects who gets the Coke.

examples.ja: 書類選考に通った。
examples.en: I passed the document screening.

items.note: Job hunting word: 書類選考 (CV screening). Same sound as 先行 (Level 14) and 専攻 (major).

meanings: title (of a book, film or song)

mnemonic.meaning: The title (題) name (名). A book or film title.
mnemonic.reading: DIE, MAY (だいめい): "May Die" is the film's title.

examples.ja: その映画の題名を忘れてしまった。
examples.en: I've forgotten the title of that film.

items.note: タイトル means the same and is more common in speech.

mnemonic.meaning: 諺 has 言 (words): wise words passed down. A proverb.
mnemonic.reading: KOTO, WAZA (ことわざ): the koto player knows every proverb.

examples.ja: 「猿も木から落ちる」という諺がある。
examples.en: There's a saying, 'Even monkeys fall from trees.'

items.note: Usually written in kana: ことわざ.

mnemonic.meaning: The party (党) out in the field (野), not in power. The opposition party.
mnemonic.reading: YA, TOE (やとう): "Yah!" The opposition party steps on the ruling party's toe.

examples.ja: 野党は政府の案に反対した。
examples.en: The opposition party opposed the government's plan.

items.note: Opposite: 与党 (よとう), the ruling party.

mnemonic.meaning: "YO, SUE (よす)! Stop it! Quit it!" You give up arguing with Sue.

examples.ja: 危ないから、よしなさい。
examples.en: It's dangerous, so stop it.

items.note: Spoken. よせよ = cut it out. Like やめる, but more casual or old-fashioned.

mnemonic.meaning: Wrap (包) and dress (装) it up. Packaging.
mnemonic.reading: HO, SO (ほうそう): "Ho, so pretty!" the wrapping paper. Same sound as 放送 (broadcast).

examples.ja: プレゼント用に包装してもらえますか。
examples.en: Could you gift-wrap it for me?

items.note: 包装紙 = wrapping paper. Same sound as 放送 (broadcast).

mnemonic.meaning: 暮 has 日 (sun) sinking under 莫: the sun going down. Dusk, the end of the year.
mnemonic.reading: COO, RAY (くれ): at dusk, a pigeon coos in the last ray of sun.

examples.ja: 年の暮れは何かと忙しい。
examples.en: The end of the year is busy with one thing and another.

items.note: 年の暮れ / 年末 = year end. 夕暮れ = dusk. From 暮れる, to get dark.

mnemonic.meaning: 禅 has 礻 (altar): meditation at the altar. Zen.
mnemonic.reading: ZEN (ぜん): Zen Buddhism.

examples.ja: 京都の寺で禅を体験した。
examples.en: I tried Zen meditation at a temple in Kyoto.

items.note: 座禅 = seated Zen meditation. Same sound as 善 (Level 14), goodness.

mnemonic.meaning: A voice (声) that's clear (明). A statement, an announcement.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, MAY (せいめい): May says her official statement. Same sound as 生命 (life).

examples.ja: 政府は声明を発表した。
examples.en: The government issued a statement.

items.note: An official statement: 共同声明 (joint statement). Same sound as 生命 (Level 6), life.

mnemonic.meaning: 諮 has 言 (words): you ask for words of advice. To consult.
mnemonic.reading: HACK-A-RUE (はかる): you consult a hacker and rue it. Same sound as 計る (measure).

examples.ja: その件は会議に諮ることにした。
examples.en: We decided to refer the matter to the committee.

items.note: Formal and official. Same sound as 計る (Level 12, measure) and 図る (plan).

mnemonic.meaning: The late (故) person (人). The deceased.
mnemonic.reading: COACH GIN (こじん): you drink gin for the late coach. Same sound as 個人 (individual).

examples.ja: 葬式で故人の思い出を語った。
examples.en: I talked about my memories of the deceased at the funeral.

items.note: Polite, used at funerals. Same sound as 個人 (individual).

mnemonic.meaning: Acid (酸) nature (性). Acidic.
mnemonic.reading: SUN, SAY (さんせい): the sun says the rain is acidic. Same sound as 賛成 (agreement).

examples.ja: この土は酸性が強い。
examples.en: This soil is strongly acidic.

items.note: 酸性雨 = acid rain. Opposite: アルカリ性. Same sound as 賛成 (agreement).

mnemonic.meaning: The doctor's (医) institution (院). A clinic.
mnemonic.reading: EE, IN (いいん): "Eee!" You go in the clinic. Same sound as 委員 (committee member).

examples.ja: 近所の医院で風邪を診てもらった。
examples.en: I saw a doctor at the local clinic about my cold.

items.note: Usually a small private practice: 山田医院. A hospital is 病院. Same sound as 委員 (committee member).

mnemonic.meaning: New (新) excitement (興). Emerging, rising.
mnemonic.reading: SHIN, COKE (しんこう): a new Coke brand is emerging.

examples.ja: 新興国の経済が成長している。
examples.en: The economies of emerging countries are growing.

items.note: Used before a noun: 新興国 (emerging nation), 新興住宅地 (new housing area). Same sound as 振興 (Level 22) and 信仰 (Level 11).

mnemonic.meaning: 蒔 has 艹 (plant): you plant the seeds. To sow.
mnemonic.reading: MACK (まく): Mack sows seeds in the field. Same sound as 撒く (scatter).

examples.ja: 春に花の種を蒔いた。
examples.en: I sowed flower seeds in spring.

items.note: Only for seeds. 撒く (Level 16) is to scatter or sprinkle. Both are often written まく.

mnemonic.meaning: Hills (丘) and mounds (陵). Hill country.
mnemonic.reading: CUE, RYO (きゅうりょう): on cue, Ryo runs across the hills. Same sound as 給料 (salary).

examples.ja: 町の北には丘陵が広がっている。
examples.en: Hills stretch out to the north of the town.

items.note: Formal, for geography. 丘 (おか) on its own is a hill. Same sound as 給料 (salary).

mnemonic.meaning: The way you usually go (行), out of habit (慣). Customary practice.
mnemonic.reading: CAN, COKE (かんこう): it's customary to drink a can of Coke. Same sound as 観光 (sightseeing).

examples.ja: 年功序列は日本の企業の慣行だった。
examples.en: Seniority-based promotion was a custom at Japanese companies.

items.note: Business and legal. 習慣 is a personal habit. Same sound as 観光 (sightseeing).

mnemonic.meaning: Study (学) of languages (語). Language study.
mnemonic.reading: GO, GACK (ごがく): you go study languages. GACK, so many verbs!

examples.ja: 彼女は語学が得意だ。
examples.en: She's good at languages.

items.note: 語学学校 = language school. 言語学 = linguistics.

mnemonic.meaning: "KETCH-UP? EE (けち)!" The stingy cheapskate won't share his ketchup.

examples.ja: 彼はけちだから、絶対におごらない。
examples.en: He's stingy, so he never treats anyone.

items.note: Often written ケチ. けちをつける = to find fault.

mnemonic.meaning: An air (気) body (体). A gas.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, TIE (きたい): the key to the gas tank is tied on. Same sound as 期待 (expectation).

examples.ja: 水は熱すると気体になる。
examples.en: Water turns into a gas when heated.

items.note: 固体 (solid), 液体 (liquid), 気体 (gas). Same sound as 期待 (expectation).

mnemonic.meaning: Wild (荒) and abandoned (廃). Ruin, devastation.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, HIGH (こうはい): the Coke factory is in ruins. Same sound as 後輩 (junior).

examples.ja: 戦争で町は荒廃した。
examples.en: The town was devastated by war.

items.note: Formal. Same sound as 後輩 (junior).

mnemonic.meaning: Pick (採) and gather (集). Collecting specimens.
mnemonic.reading: SIGH, SHOE (さいしゅう): you sigh, collecting bugs in your shoe. Same sound as 最終 (final).

examples.ja: 子供の頃、夏休みに昆虫採集をした。
examples.en: As a child, I collected insects in the summer holidays.

items.note: 昆虫採集 = collecting insects. Same sound as 最終 (final).

mnemonic.meaning: Songs (歌) and ballads (謡). Popular songs.
mnemonic.reading: CAR, YO (かよう): "Car, yo!" a popular song. Same sound as 通う (commute).

examples.ja: 祖母は昭和の歌謡曲が好きだ。
examples.en: My grandmother likes Showa-era pop songs.

items.note: 歌謡曲 = Japanese pop songs (mostly older ones). Same sound as 通う (to commute).

mnemonic.meaning: A woman (女) of history (史). Madam, Ms.
mnemonic.reading: JOE, SHE (じょし): Joe and she, Madam Curie.

examples.ja: キュリー女史は有名な科学者だ。
examples.en: Madame Curie is a famous scientist.

items.note: A respectful, old-fashioned title for a woman of achievement. Same sound as 女子 (girls).

mnemonic.meaning: Words (語) and phrases (句). Phrases.
mnemonic.reading: GO, COO (ごく): "Go, coo!" the pigeon learns new words and phrases.

examples.ja: 分からない語句を辞書で調べた。
examples.en: I looked up the words and phrases I didn't know in the dictionary.

items.note: Common in exam instructions. Same sound as ごく (extremely).
